# Per-binary floors for the `default` leg of CI's rust-test job (Round 40, D2-8).
# Read by .github/scripts/test-count.sh (5th argument): every binary listed must
# run and pass at least its floor, so deleting tests from one security suite
# fails CI even when another suite grew. Lines are `<floor> <binary>`, the binary
# as cargo names it. The floors are the counts of a full run of this leg at
# 1ae2066 with the Round 40 assurance changes
# (`cargo test --locked --profile ci-test` with this leg's flags);
# lower one only in a reviewed change that says why. The suites listed are the
# security-critical ones (ci-scripts.test.sh names the patterns and fails when one
# is neither floored here nor named below as not in this leg).
